items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I was right behind Hank. Then I could always tell when Benny was going to call me, because Hank would call me up first.

ctx.x: Who else can you remember seeing there? I think you mentioned Duke, right?
Oh Ellington, yes. Lucky Millinder, Benny Carter. Gee whiz. I can't remember all of them, but everybody used to play there, because it was a beautiful theater, you know?
